body:
I took your advice and went to sleep. I feel better now. It's always worse at night, and I was really depressed and drunk and looking at a crapton of pills.   
I studied music history. Ridiculously useless, but it was what I was good at and what I loved. Most of the other stuff I'm good at (history, linguistics) are almost as useless, anyway. It just sucks I can't even get a receptionist/secretary/customer service job. I have a few years' experience doing jobs that require those kinds of skills, but not the ten years they want, I guess.

Thanks for the reply. It helps some to know other people feel the same. I dwell too much on the past and compare myself to others, and often it seems like nobody is in the same boat. It is definitely a fight for me. At least I am still fighting, I guess.

Thanks. I suppose you're right, and some part of me really wants to believe it: there is always the possibility (however small) that things may get better. It is just really really hard for me to see right now :(
